label: kizuna_head_d_01
text: Thank you again for your outstanding work on\nOperation Starfall.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: kizuna_head_d_02
text: I cannot tell you how relieved I am that we were\nable to help Miss Penny as we did.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: kizuna_head_d_03
text: And I know she is exceedingly grateful to you for\nyour part in all this.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: kizuna_head_d_04
text: So, I have one more thing to ask of you—though\nthe request is admittedly of a delicate nature.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: kizuna_head_d_05
text: Do you think you could continue being good\nfriends with Miss Penny as you have thus far?[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: kizuna_head_d_06
text: I must say...I truly am glad to have you as one\nof my students at the academy.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: kizuna_head_d_07
text: I believe you’ve more than earned this small\ntoken of my appreciation.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: kizuna_head_d_08
text: I hope that you will always stay just as wonderful\nas you are now, M[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0305)]asteriss [VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: kizuna_head_d_system_01
text: You formed a close bond with Director Clavell!
